source:
version: '1'
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: truth-gauge-hashprice
protocol: generic
name: Gauge hashprice reference (Blockstream + Blockchain.com)
description: >
  Keyless public reference for Bitcoin hashprice at an exact block height. Computes
  reward x 144 / network hashrate from the block's own reward and difficulty, read from two
  independent chain indexers (blockstream.info and blockchain.info) that must agree within 0.1%.
base_url: https://gauge.129.121.144.223.sslip.io
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
- path: /hashprice
  external_path: /hashprice
  method: GET
  description: >
    Bitcoin hashprice at exactly block_height, in sats per PH/s per day, as hashprice_sats_per_ph_day.
    USE THIS for MINING_HASHPRICE_VERIFY_GENERAL. Send block_height in the query string.
  intents:
  - MINING_HASHPRICE_VERIFY_GENERAL
  params:
    query:
      required:
      - name: block_height
        type: integer
        intents:
        - '*'
        description: Bitcoin mainnet block height, a whole number from 0 to the current chain tip.
semantics:
  supported_intents:
  - MINING_HASHPRICE_VERIFY_GENERAL
